description:
That tiny tail wag told them she wasn’t ready to give up  ❤️

Espresso was poisoned, had a broken rib and couldn’t stand on her own, but Niall and his rescue team from @wearehappydoggo saw little signs that she wasn’t giving up. Dodo editor Monica shares how they helped her slowly regain her strength, from her first tiny tail wag to the day she finally stood up and walked on her own.

Hosted by Monica
Produced by Anita
fulltitle: Poisoned Dog Who Couldn't Stand Takes Her First Steps | The Dodo
